-- Let me see all pick_details
WITH pick_details AS (
    SELECT 
        pl.order_id,
        pl.product_id,
        p.name as product_name,
        CASE WHEN pl.qty < i.qty THEN pl.qty ELSE i.qty END as effective_pick
    FROM picking_line pl
    JOIN products p ON pl.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_with_dims i ON pl.location_id = i.location_id AND pl.product_id = i.product_id
)
SELECT * FROM pick_details ORDER BY product_id, order_id
